checks.scope: Frozen round-one manuscript and snapshot identity

checks.method: Compared manuscript Sections 1 and 4 with GLOBAL67-ordinary-theorem.md, Literal statement and Mathematical proof by maximum degree.
checks.observation: Both use finite simple exactly four-uniform families, permit the empty sunflower core, reduce larger families to exactly 68 members, and conclude the maximum-size inequality M(4,3)<=67. The manuscript warns that minimum positive degree is recomputed after restriction.

checks.method: Compared manuscript Sections 2 and 7 with EXTERNAL-H27-JIN-SCOPE.md and the assurance paragraphs of GLOBAL67-ordinary-theorem.md.
checks.observation: The text discloses that the full H27 ledger was not replayed locally, that Jin's exact theorem was checked through Nikiforov's restatement, and that the global theorem is not assembled into an end-to-end Lean closure. These limits are consistently stated in the inspected documents.

checks.method: Read the manuscript definitions and trace-count formulas; followed cap15's pointer to LOW15-R15-rho7-classification.md and read the opening model definition; inspected D16-complete-argument.md's graph representation.
checks.observation: The companion gives R16 explicitly using four hubs and two disjoint triads and gives A_k adjacency differences k through 2k-1 modulo 3k-1. These definitions are absent from the manuscript, which uses the corresponding models and fibre counts. Bare N and the Section 6 trace variables also require clarification.

checks.method: Compared manuscript Section 5.2 with LOW15-complete-argument.md's rho<=6 section and R15-rho6-completed-evidence.md.
checks.observation: The universal fifteen-triple conclusion agrees across these sources, and the manuscript correctly describes a derived eleven-point support bound before the finite trees. The companion identifies the degree2 reduction, independent ordinary reconstruction, and tree-replay records; the manuscript does not attach their specific locators to Theorem 2. No tree or motif enumeration was rerun in this review.

findings.disposition: Supply the requested definitions or precise definition locators. This is an exposition defect, not a demonstrated false inequality; the companion LOW15-R15-rho7-classification.md already supplies an explicit ten-point R16 construction.
findings.statement: Section 3 calls the small-rank structure explicit but names canonical P10 without constructing it, and R16 is used without its hub/triad model. Sections 5.1 and 6 introduce bare N, singleton classes, and several trace-count symbols without complete definitions. A reader cannot reconstruct the displayed deletion inequalities from the manuscript's notation alone.

findings.disposition: Add a compact obligation-to-source map so the article functions as a usable proof guide. The inspected companion assemblies contain substantially more precise dependency pointers, so this does not require reproducing every computational detail in the main text.
findings.statement: The final companion map names broad assembly documents but does not associate crucial compressed claims with exact proof obligations. For example Section 5.2 says the low-degree argument excludes degrees 1 and 2, while Section 6 invokes the cap14 exclusion, rho=7 classification, and star-fibre requirements without local source locators.

findings.disposition: Retain these qualifications. This review checked their consistency with the supplied source-scope and global-proof documents, not the completeness of the external literature search.
findings.statement: Theorem 1 distinguishes the maximum size 67 from the forcing cardinality 68, includes empty sunflower cores, and treats prior theorems as imports rather than locally verified Lean roots. The novelty language is expressly bounded by the located source search.

required_revisions: Add a compact definitions paragraph or table before the case arguments: give a literal construction or exact definition locator for P10 and R16; specify the meaning and support-disjointness convention of component sums; define exact singleton classes, residual count r, and the shorthand N used in bounds such as N<=44; define the A_k indexing convention before the fibre calculations. Define S,P,T,q and p_ij,s_i explicitly as trace counts when introduced in Section 6.

Replace the undifferentiated companion filename list with a concise obligation-to-source map, or add direct locators at the relevant proof steps. In particular identify the arbitrary-support low-degree reduction and three finite tree obligations for Theorem 2, the rho=7 classification and its two deletion contradictions, the degree16 cover/fibre bridges, and the cap15 cover/fibre bridge. State each obligation's conclusion and whether it is imported, proved in ordinary prose, or checked by a named finite procedure.
content.summary: The literal extremal statement, maximum-size convention, arbitrary-support scope, and ordinary-versus-formal assurance distinction are clearly framed. The maximum-degree architecture is readable at overview level. Revision is needed to define the structural models and shorthand used in the proofs and to make the principal companion obligations directly locatable. This round inspected exposition and selected proof-source statements; it does not certify the finite leaves or the complete theorem.
